hero.name: Maël Rabot
hero.tagline: I mentor developers at <0>Epitech</0> and build <1>Lucy</1>, an open-source framework that makes robots simpler to use.

tracks.title: Two tracks, one craft.
tracks.intro: My time is split between mentoring students through their projects at Epitech and building Lucy, an open-source robotics framework, with Lucy-Robotics.

mentoring.label: Mentoring
mentoring.summary: I mentor international exchange students and Master of Science (MSc 1 & 2) students throughout their projects: code reviews, project defenses and one-to-one follow-up, helping them find the answer rather than giving it.
points: Mentoring international exchange students and MSc 1 & 2 students, in English
Code reviews and project defenses in C, C++, Python, TypeScript/Vue.js, Elixir and DevOps
Socratic mentoring: building autonomy, architectural thinking and debugging habits
Individual follow-up: organisation, work habits and well-being
Behind the scenes: preparing activity schedules and coordinating with other teams (Erasmus managers, French teachers, administration…)

building.label: Building
building.summary: With Lucy-Robotics, we build Lucy: an open-source framework that makes robots simpler to use, whatever the robot. I work on the architecture and lead the product roadmap.
points: ROS 2 framework architecture and development (C++, ros2_control)
Team leadership, backlog prioritisation and sprint planning
Public documentation, roadmap and community management

lucy.title: Lucy
lucy.subtitle: > One platform // Any robot
lucy.description: Lucy is an open-source robotics framework that makes robots simpler to use. Its core runs all the ROS 2 logic and installs in a few commands on macOS, Windows or Linux. Robots plug in on one side (InMoov and the SO-101 arm today), control interfaces on the other: the Lucy Control Panel, a CLI, or one you build yourself.

diagram.label: Architecture of the Lucy stack
diagram.hint: Hover or select a block to learn more.

lcp.title: Lucy Control Panel
lcp.description: The main interface: a web app to drive the robot, move each actuator and follow its telemetry in real time.

cli.title: CLI
cli.description: A command-line interface shipped with Lucy, for scripting and quick control from a terminal.

huri.title: HuRI · AI
huri.description: Our AI framework (speech-to-speech, multi-layer memory, gesture grounding) sends its intentions to the robot through Lucy.

custom.title: + Your interface
custom.description: Everything is open source: plug in your own interface, or build a new one on top of Lucy.

core.title: Lucy core
core.description: The heart of the stack. It runs all the ROS 2 logic (C++, Rust and Python) and exposes every robot to every interface the same way.

packages.title: lucy_ros_packages
packages.description: Lucy's custom ROS 2 packages, built on ros2_control: the common layer between interfaces and hardware.

firmware.title: lucy_embedded_firmware
firmware.description: The firmware running on the robot's electronics, linking the ROS 2 stack to motors and sensors.

ws.title: lucy_ws
ws.description: The workspace that pulls everything together, with Python scripts and installers: up and running in a few commands on macOS, Windows or Linux, without Docker (pixi + RoboStack).

inmoov.title: InMoov
inmoov.description: The open-source 3D-printed humanoid created by Gaël Langevin, our main development platform.

so101.title: SO-101 arm
so101.description: An open-source robotic arm, supported by Lucy today.

more.title: + Your robot
more.description: Lucy is robot-agnostic: new robots join the stack as the community grows.

skills.title: What I work with
skills.intro: From low-level C to web interfaces and robotics, plus the human skills that make a team work.

about.title: Beyond the code
about.p1: I'm completing a Master's degree in computer science at Epitech. My passion for technology drives me to explore many fields, always looking for new challenges and things to learn.
about.p2: I enjoy low-level programming, object-oriented design, web development and robotics, and I'm curious about game development and graphics programming.
